title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Our client is seeking a Customer Service Advisor to join their team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Maximise customer awareness of all available company services.
- Ensure the highest level of customer care and satisfaction at all times.
- Maintain excellent standards of departmental administration.
- Organise daily collection and delivery operations.
- Monitor sales against objectives.
- Track Customer Satisfaction Indicators.
- Maintain Bodyshop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Customer Service Advisor

Customer Awareness and Service Promotion:
- Promote all Bodyshop and Retailer services to maximise customer awareness.
- Ensure customers are informed about all products and services available.
- Proactively approach customers and assist with inquiries relating to vehicle repairs, parts, and vehicle sales.

Customer Care and Satisfaction:
- Maintain a visible presence at the reception desk, promptly addressing customer queries in person or by telephone.
- Respond to customer questions regarding technical issues clearly and without excessive jargon, or refer to the appropriate team member as necessary.
- Handle dissatisfied customers calmly and escalate complaints to the Bodyshop Manager.
- Initiate new claims on the management system, maintain accurate customer records, and follow up as required.
- Manage initial customer contact and bookings in accordance with company and insurance policies.
- Follow established procedures when issuing courtesy cars, ensuring all paperwork is correctly completed and copies of driving licences are obtained when applicable.
- Maintain up-to-date, computerised customer records, documenting all communications and events thoroughly.
- Manage communications systems with customers and insurers as required.
- Assist the Bodyshop Manager with administrative tasks as needed.
- Ensure compliance with all health and safety, environmental, and company policies.
- Receive and register payments for work completed, adhering to company procedures for verification, handling, and depositing of cash.
- Prepare and present invoices promptly upon job completion, ensuring all work is accurately detailed and charged, and obtain payment in line with company protocols.
- Ensure all job pack paperwork, including wheel alignment and final inspection documents, is scanned and filed correctly.

Collection and Delivery Operations:
- Coordinate daily collection and delivery operations effectively.
- Maintain close liaison with parts and workshop teams, attending daily production meetings.
- Notify customers promptly upon completion of work and arrange convenient vehicle returns.
- Ensure adequate resources are available to meet collection and delivery requirements.
- Monitor and manage loan car requirements in coordination with workshop control.

Salary and Benefits:
- Salary: £30,000, rising to £32,000 following successful probationary period.
- Excellent benefits package.

title: Business Coordinator/ Junior PA
description:
Business Coordinator & Junior PA

Location: Gerrards Cross, Buckinghamshire
Salary: £30,000 £35,000, depending on experience
Working pattern: Hybrid minimum three days per week in person
Travel: Occasional travel to Central London
Requirement: Full UK driving licence and access to a car

Are you confident, highly organised and naturally driven? Are you the kind of person who spots what needs doing and makes it happen?

We are recruiting a Business Coordinator & Junior PA to work closely with a dynamic entrepreneur and Managing Director of a growing consultancy. This is a varied and influential role combining business coordination, operational support, reporting, systems administration and personal assistance.

You will act as the Managing Director s eyes and ears across the business, helping to connect sales, marketing, project delivery and operations. You will need to be confident working with different personalities, comfortable holding people accountable and able to turn conversations into clear actions and results.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious coordinator or junior PA who wants greater responsibility and exposure to how a growing business operates.

The role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as a central point of coordination between the Managing Director and teams across sales, marketing, operations and project delivery
- Monitoring priorities, actions and deadlines, following up with colleagues to ensure commitments are completed
- Identifying and escalating potential risks, delays and operational issues
- Supporting internal meetings, planning cycles and business reviews
- Maintaining budgets, financial trackers and management spreadsheets
- Producing reports covering sales pipelines, project progress, utilisation and other key business measures
- Helping to establish clear processes, responsibilities and reporting routines
- Supporting recruitment administration and wider business projects
- Managing the company s social budget and organising regular team events
- Managing the Managing Director s diary, meetings and appointments
- Arranging travel, accommodation and other logistics
- Providing occasional personal and household administration support
- Travelling to Central London when required

About you

We are looking for someone who is:
- Driven, confident and proactive, with a strong personality and a positive approach
- A natural organiser who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion
- Comfortable working directly with an entrepreneurial Managing Director in a busy, fast-changing environment
- Confident dealing with people at all levels and able to be firm while remaining professional and respectful
- Numerically capable and comfortable working with budgets, trackers and business data
- Technically confident and able to learn CRM, project-management and reporting systems quickly
- Process-driven, with the confidence to introduce improvements and encourage others to follow agreed ways of working
- Analytical, commercially aware and able to identify potential problems
- A clear and professional written and verbal communicator
- Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential business and personal information
- Flexible and willing to support across a broad range of business activities

Experience required
- At least one year s experience in a PA, team coordination, business support, project coordination or similar role
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills
- Experience coordinating people, projects, deadlines or processes
- Confidence using CRM systems or other business technology
- Experience managing budgets, trackers or numerical information
- A full UK driving licence and access to a car
- The ability to work from Gerrards Cross for a minimum of three days per week and travel to Central London when required

Previous experience in a small, growing or entrepreneurial business would be particularly valuable.

Package and benefits
- Salary of £30,000 £35,000, depending on experience
- Annual profit-share scheme
- 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
- Your birthday off

This role would suit someone who wants more than a traditional administration position. You will be close to the centre of the business, trusted with meaningful responsibility and given the opportunity to make a visible impact as the company grows.

title: Sales Support Coordinator
description:
We're looking for a highly organised Sales Support Coordinator to play a central role in supporting the successful delivery of sales opportunities, bids, tenders, proposals and presentations.

Our client is a well-established technology solutions provider working across Sales, Procurement, Project Management and external partners to deliver for its customers. This role sits within the Pre-Sales department, reporting to the Divisional Director, and offers the chance to be at the heart of a fast-moving, collaborative sales function.

The Role

The Sales Support Coordinator ensures that all documentation, information and submissions are completed accurately, professionally and within required timescales. Working closely with Sales, Procurement, Project Management and external partners, you'll be highly organised, detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities while coordinating activities across a range of stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Bids & Tender Coordination: Coordinate the preparation and submission of bids, tenders, proposals and RFI responses. Review tender documents and specifications to ensure all submission requirements are identified and addressed, maintain tender trackers and monitor progress against deadlines, coordinate internal contributions from Sales, Procurement, Technical and Delivery teams, and ensure all tender responses are accurate, compliant, professionally formatted and submitted on time. Assist with the production of customer presentations and supporting documentation, and support bid review and approval processes prior to submission.

Sales & Project Support: Assist the sales team in preparing quotations, proposals and project cost documentation. Liaise with suppliers and distributors to obtain pricing, product information and supporting documentation, support project handovers from Sales to Delivery teams, assist with obtaining information and pricing for project variations and change requests, and coordinate administrative activities that support the successful delivery of sales opportunities and projects.

Document & Process Management: Maintain bid libraries, templates, case studies and sales collateral. Manage bid and project documentation within SharePoint and other company systems, ensure documents are branded and formatted in line with company standards, maintain manufacturer, supplier and partner contact information, and continually support process improvements within the sales support and bid functions.

Stakeholder Coordination: Act as a key point of coordination between internal departments and external partners. Build positive working relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, consultants and clients, communicate effectively with stakeholders to gather and track information required for submissions, and support collaboration across Sales, Procurement, Project Management and Delivery teams.

Reporting & Administration: Maintain accurate records of bids, opportunities and submissions. Update pipeline and tender tracking systems with the latest information, produce reports and updates as required by management, and ensure all bid-related records and documentation remain organised, current and easily accessible.

What We Are Looking For

Experience: Previous experience in a sales support, bid coordination, administration or project support role.

Skills: Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Systems: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, along with experience using SharePoint and document management systems.

Approach: Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with a professional, proactive and adaptable approach to work, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable: Experience within the Audio Visual (AV), Technology, IT or Workplace Solutions sector, experience supporting tender or bid submissions, knowledge of public sector tender processes, and familiarity with project coordination practices.

Core Competencies

Organisation & Planning

Attention to Detail

Communication & Stakeholder Management

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

What's on Offer
- Private Health Care
- The opportunity to work at the heart of a fast-paced, collaborative sales and bid function
- Exposure to a wide range of technology and workplace solutions projects
- A supportive, team-oriented working environment

If you are a highly organised sales support or bid coordination professional looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV.

title: Procurement Assistant
description:
Procurement Assistant - Office Based 5 Days Per Week
About the Opportunity
Are you highly organised, detail-oriented and passionate about delivering exceptional customer service? We're recruiting on behalf of a growing business seeking a Procurement Assistant to support the successful delivery of exciting projects.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous procurement, purchasing, account management or project coordination experience who enjoys building strong relationships, managing multiple priorities and ensuring projects run smoothly from order through to delivery.
Working closely with an experienced and collaborative team, you'll play a key role in coordinating suppliers, managing orders and providing outstanding service throughout the procurement process.
The Role
As Procurement Assistant, you'll be responsible for supporting the procurement function while acting as a key point of contact for suppliers and clients. No two days will be the same, and you'll enjoy working across multiple projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Key Responsibilities
- Build and maintain excellent relationships with suppliers and clients.
- Raise, process and monitor purchase orders.
- Coordinate deliveries and track project timelines.
- Liaise with suppliers regarding lead times, availability and order updates.
- Resolve delivery issues quickly and professionally.
- Maintain accurate procurement records and project documentation.
- Support the wider project team with administrative and coordination tasks.
- Monitor outstanding orders and ensure projects remain on schedule.
- Assist with supplier negotiations and obtaining competitive quotations.
- Deliver a high level of customer service throughout each project.

About You
We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and enjoys working with people.
You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within procurement, purchasing, buying, account management or project coordination.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
- A proactive, positive and solutions-focused approach.
- Good commercial awareness.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Experience working with procurement or ERP systems would be advantageous but isn't essential.

What's in it for You?
- Join a friendly, supportive and collaborative team.
- Opportunity to work on exciting, design-led projects.
- Excellent exposure to procurement, supplier management and project coordination.
- Career development opportunities within a growing business.
- Beautiful office environment with a team-first culture.

If you're looking for a varied role where you can develop your procurement and account management skills while working on exciting projects, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Job Title: Service Delivery Coordinator
Location: Milton Keynes
Work Model: Hybrid

Are you a highly organised professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy bringing people, schedules and priorities together to achieve outstanding results?

If so, we are looking for a motivated Service Delivery Coordinator to join our Client Services and Operational Delivery teams on a full-time and permanent basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys problem-solving, relationship building, and ensuring that business commitments are delivered efficiently and effectively.

About the role:

In this role, you will play a key part in coordinating internal resources, managing schedules, supporting operational delivery, and providing an exceptional experience for both internal and external stakeholders. Working closely with colleagues across multiple teams, you will help maximise diary availability and achieve performance targets whilst contributing to operational success.

What you'll be doing:
- Proactive diary management which involves managing schedules, bookings, and resource allocation for our Audit and Training delivery teams.
- Coordinating activities across internal teams and external stakeholders to meet operational targets and service commitments.
- Monitoring workloads, utilisation levels, and key performance indicators to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Communicating confidently with clients and colleagues via telephone, email, and virtual meetings.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders to resolve issues, manage expectations, and support business objectives.
- Handle administrative and system-based processes accurately and within agreed service levels.
- Support planning activities, reporting requirements, and operational projects as required.
- Manage changing priorities whilst finding practical solutions to scheduling and delivery challenges.

Required experience:
- Experience in a planning, coordination, administration, customer service, and/or an operations support role.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Experience working to targets, KPIs, or service level agreements.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to finding solutions.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team.
- Knowledge of systems such as SAP, Salesforce, or similar would be desirable.

Language Requirements: English with European languages desirable e.g. German, Dutch, Spanish, Italian and French.

What will make you successful?

In this role, you'll be someone who:
- Puts customers and stakeholders at the heart of everything you do.
- Enjoys collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.
- Remains calm and resilient when priorities change.
- Takes ownership and accountability for delivering results.
- Is adaptable, agile, and constantly looking for ways to improve processes.

Why join us?

You'll join a collaborative and supportive team where your contribution has a real impact on business performance and customer satisfaction. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and provide opportunities to develop your career within a dynamic and growing organisation.

Our benefits
BSI offers an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 27-days annual leave excludin Bank Holidays, paid sick leave, health insurance, life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, income protection, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid parental leave, adoption leave, compassionate leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Salary Range
The base salary for this position can range from £26,775 - £28,000 per annum; actual compensation is based on various factors, including but not limited to; candidate competencies, level of experience, education, location, divisional budget and internal peer compensation comparisons.

description: We are looking for a Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly and supportive team at Purbeck Health Centre. This is an important front-line role where you will help patients access the right care while supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Friendly, approachable and professional Reliable, organised and able to manage competing priorities Confident communicating with patients and colleagues Comfortable using computers and learning new systems Able to work independently and as part of a team Committed to providing excellent patient service Previous experience in a GP practice or healthcare setting would be helpful, but it is not essential. Full training will be provided, and you will be supported by an experienced team who take pride in delivering excellent care and service to our patients. If you are looking for a rewarding and varied role where you can make a real difference to patients every day, we would love to hear from you. What you will be doing Answering telephone calls and responding to patient enquiries Welcoming patients at the reception desk Booking and managing appointments Completing a variety of administrative tasks Working closely with our clinical and administrative teams Handling confidential information professionally The role is busy and varied, so you will need excellent communication and organisational skills, good attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm under pressure. Job Description Job title: Receptionist/Administrator Location: Purbeck Health Centre, Milton Keynes Hours: Working pattern to be agreed Reports to: Reception Lead/Practice Manager The Receptionist/Administrator will be one of the first points of contact for patients and visitors. The postholder will provide a professional and welcoming reception service, manage telephone calls and patient enquiries, and complete a range of computer-based administrative duties. The role is essential to supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and ensuring patients receive a helpful, efficient and respectful service. Welcome patients and visitors in a friendly, caring and professional manner. Check patients in for appointments and assist with general enquiries. Support the smooth flow of patients through the practice. Communicate with clinicians and other team members when required. Keep the reception area calm, tidy and organised. Respect patients privacy and maintain confidentiality at all times. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and courteously. Book, amend and cancel appointments accurately using SystmOne. Respond to general enquiries and direct patients to the appropriate service or member of staff. Follow practice procedures when receiving urgent or emergency calls and escalate concerns immediately where required. Take clear and accurate messages and pass them to the appropriate clinician or administrator promptly. Communicate sensitively with patients who may be worried, distressed or frustrated. Update patient contact details, appointment information and records accurately. Process online appointment requests, messages and administrative queries. Maintain accurate patient records, tasks and worklists on SystmOne. Monitor emails, call queues and other practice communication systems. Support the smooth running of the days appointments and reception services. Complete general administrative duties, including printing letters, preparing lists and entering data. Follow practice procedures for filing, communication and information sharing. Work closely with reception colleagues to maintain appropriate cover for the front desk and telephone lines. Communicate clearly and professionally with clinicians, administrators and management. Provide additional cover during colleagues annual leave or sickness where required. Attend team meetings, training sessions and practice updates. Contribute ideas that could improve patient services or working processes. Promote a positive, respectful and supportive working environment. Follow all practice policies and procedures, including those relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, information governance and data protection. Maintain a professional, respectful and positive approach. Report incidents, risks or concerns promptly to the Reception Lead or Practice Manager. Complete all required mandatory training. Keep knowledge of practice systems, policies and procedures up to date. Work within the responsibilities and boundaries of the role. Excellent communication and telephone skills. A friendly, polite and approachable manner. Confidence using computers and learning new systems. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Ability to remain calm and professional in a busy environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. A reliable, flexible and supportive approach to teamwork. Understanding of the importance of patient confidentiality. Commitment to providing a high standard of patient service. Previous experience in a GP practice, healthcare setting or customer-facing role. Experience using SystmOne or another clinical record system. The postholder must promote equality, diversity and inclusion and treat all patients, visitors and colleagues with dignity, fairness and respect. The postholder must take reasonable care of their own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by their work. Any hazards, incidents or concerns must be reported promptly in accordance with practice procedures. All patient, staff and practice information must be treated as confidential. The postholder must follow UK GDPR, data protection requirements, NHS information governance standards and practice policies. The postholder will be expected to: Uphold the values and reputation of Purbeck Health Centre. Follow all practice policies, procedures and applicable NHS requirements. Take responsibility for their own learning, training and professional development. Contribute to a positive, supportive and inclusive workplace. Carry out other reasonable duties appropriate to the role. This job description provides an overview of the role and is not exhaustive. Duties may change as the needs of the practice develop, following appropriate discussion with the postholder and their line manager.

title: Administrator
description: UNLOCK YOUR BEST WORK LIFE + make a difference for every patient We're looking for a proactive and customer-focused Administrator to join our Private Pay Services team, supporting both self-pay and NHS patients through their diagnostic imaging journey. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy healthcare environment where you'll play an important role in delivering an outstanding patient experience. Working closely with clinical and administrative colleagues, you'll help ensure referrals, appointments, reports and patient communications are managed efficiently and professionally. This is a part-time role working 30 hours per week across 4 days . Candidates must be available to work Wednesday, Thursday and Friday , with flexibility on the fourth working day. As our Administrator, you will be: Processing incoming referrals and ensuring all clinical and demographic information is accurate and complete. Managing and distributing diagnostic reports to referring clinicians and patients. Supporting the sharing of images and reports with NHS and private healthcare providers. Responding to patient, clinician and customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner. Supporting appointment scheduling, reception cover and data entry activities when required. Working closely with colleagues to ensure smooth patient pathways and excellent service delivery. Maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive information with professionalism and care. Contributing to a positive team environment and supporting new colleagues where appropriate. For more information, review the attached job description or contact sarah.melder@practiceplusgroup.com

title: GP Receptionist
